channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Resistance at 0.8075 remains in focus as dips find buyers
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades higher for the second consecutive day against the Swiss Franc (CHF). Downdside attempts remain shallow so far, amid a calm market mood, and the immediate trend shows a mild bullish stance, with resistance at the 0.8075 area under pressure.

item.title: Why the New Zealand Dollar may not benefit from expected RBNZ rate hike
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) continues to trade subdued against the US Dollar (USD) as markets brace for the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's (RBNZ) upcoming monetary policy decision.

item.title: US Dollar: Benign FX risk score with hawkish fed pricing – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research’s FX Risk Score note by Chua Han Teng and Daisy Sharma highlights that FX risk has risen modestly in May and June but remains below prior Middle East conflict highs.

item.title: Forex Today: Markets cling to a cautious stance after choppy action to start week
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, July 7:

item.title: Gold hangs near daily low as rising US bond yields underpin USD amid Hormuz risks
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) retains intraday negative bias through the early European session on Tuesday, though it holds above the $4,100 mark. Crude oil prices edge higher amid renewed tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, reviving inflationary concerns.

item.title: Euro: Le Pen ruling seen as low impact – ING
item.description: Francesco Pesole at ING argues that Marine Le Pen’s eligibility ruling matters more for French politics than markets, as investors have largely priced in a National Rally (RN) victory under Le Pen or Bardella with fiscal prudence.

item.title: Canadian Dollar weakens despite higher oil prices
item.description: USD/CAD gains ground for the third successive day, trading around 1.4210 during the European hours on Tuesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds ground, which could be attributed to the renewed geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: ECB's Panetta: Strait of Hormuz governance is still uncertain
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker and Governor of the Bank of Italy, Fabio Panetta, said during the European trading session on Tuesday that upside risks to inflation in the Eurozone economy remain intact, as the governance of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint to almost 20% of global

item.title: British Pound: Strong momentum eyeing 1.3410–1.3445 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights a sharp GBP/USD advance to 1.3397 and a firm close at 1.3391. Intraday, Leang sees scope for further gains toward 1.3410, though 1.3445 may stay out of reach.

item.title: Iran’s Foreign Minister Araghchi warns against US threats
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has warned through a post on X, formerly known as Twitter, that the deal with United States (US) could be hampered if the nation continues with its threats. “Negotiations on a final deal will not commence if threats continue.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ hike seen but path questioned – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) to raise rates at its July meeting to reinforce its inflation-fighting credentials, which should initially support the New Zealand Dollar (NZD).

item.title: Indian Rupee underperforms as oil prices rebound, eyes on FOMC Minutes
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) holds onto Monday’s losses against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen ticks up above 162.00 US Dollar and eases intervention risks
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) posts minor gains amid a somewhat softer US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/JPY pair has pulled back to session lows just below 162.00 from Monday's highs in the 162.40 area, easing concerns about an immediate intervention by the Japanese authorities.

item.title: Federal Reserve: New communication risks under Warsh – BNY
item.description: BNY Markets’ John Velis and David Tam examine upcoming Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes from Kevin Warsh’s first meeting as Chair.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Stability above 20-day EMA backs further upside
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) ticks lower to near 1.3380 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday. The GBP/USD pair edges down as the US Dollar gains slightly; however, the Cable is broadly upbeat.

item.title: US Dollar: Crowded support into year-end – NBC
item.description: National Bank of Canada ’s (NBC) Stéfane Marion and Kyle Dahms note the US Dollar (USD) is trading near its 2026 high as sticky United States (US) inflation and wider rate differentials underpin the currency.

item.title: Equities: Semiconductor bounce looks fragile – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists note that the S&P 500 reached a three-week high as chip stocks rebounded, led by gains in the Philly semiconductor index and Broadcom after its expanded Apple partnership.

item.title: Euro languishes at one-year lows against the British Pound despite positive German data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has failed to draw support from the upbeat German industrial figures released earlier on Tuesday and consolidates losses at one-year lows against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Japanese Yen: Mixed outlook inside 160.60–163.00 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang reports USD/JPY surged to 162.42 before closing at 162.08, leaving the pair overbought. Intraday, the bank expects consolidation between 161.50 and 162.45.

item.title: Euro Summer range holds against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes EUR/USD has been stuck between 1.1350 and 1.1450 since mid-June, with few catalysts expected over the summer.

item.title: Germany's Industrial Production unexpectedly rises faster-than-expected by 0.9% MoM in May
item.description: Germany’s industrial sector activity surprisingly grow at a faster pace of 0.9% Month-on-Month (MoM) in May, the latest data published by Destatis showed on Tuesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Turns broadly sideways below 20-day EMA
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades marginally lower at around 1.1433 during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Asian stocks fall as tech selloff sparks sharp KOSPI slump
item.description: Asian equity markets mostly decline on Tuesday as a fresh wave of technology sector selling completely overshadowed Wall Street's tech-led rally from the previous night.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds below 101.00 as fading Fed hike bets counter Hormuz risks
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles for a firm near-term direction and extends its consolidative price moves for the third straight day on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar remains subdued as US Dollar gains on renewed Hormuz tensions
item.description: NZD/USD inches lower for the second successive day, trading around 0.5700 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds ground, which could be attributed to the renewed geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Eases from two-week top; 38.2% Fibo. near 0.6955 holds the key
item.description: The AUD/USD retreats slightly from the 0.6960 area, or a two-week high, touched during the Asian session on Tuesday, and, for now, seems to have snapped a three-day winning streak.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD corrects further to near $61 as oil prices attract bids
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 1.35% to near $61.00 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen strengthens amid looming intervention risks; lacks bullish conviction
item.description: The USD/JPY pair extends the previous day's late pullback from the vicinity of mid-162.00s and attracts some follow-through sellers during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI rises above $69.00 as Iran strikes commercial vessels in Hormuz
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around $69.20 per barrel during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Crude oil prices receive a temporary boost following renewed geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.
